# Queue fixture icon attribution

The Queue diagram's MIT license does not relicense the third-party artwork referenced by its icon URLs. The e2e SVG harness retains these external references rather than embedding the icon files.

- Go Gopher artwork by **Renee French**, licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). See the [official Go Gopher attribution](https://go.dev/blog/gopher). This is the artwork referenced by `icons.terrastruct.com/dev%2Fgo.svg`.
- RabbitMQ is a trademark of Broadcom, Inc. in the U.S. and other countries. The [RabbitMQ trademark guidelines](https://www.rabbitmq.com/trademark-guidelines) distinguish name references from logo use and reserve logo use to Broadcom. The diagram's upstream RabbitMQ logo reference is preserved; the Queue MIT license is not permission for unrestricted logo reuse.
- Redis is a registered trademark of Redis Ltd. Any rights therein are reserved to Redis Ltd. See the [Redis trademark policy](https://redis.io/legal/trademark-policy/) for its separate terms.

The original diagram also references a NATS logo and four `icons.terrastruct.com/essentials` icons (`092-graph bar`, `095-download`, `195-attachment`, and `213-alarm`). Their individual artwork license provenance has not been independently established by this collection. The source repository's MIT license should not be treated as a blanket license for these third-party assets.
